brands.name: L'Oréal Professionnel
brands.code_format: Level . primary tone + secondary tone, printed twice: digits (6.34) and letters (6GC). 6.34 = level 6, gold (.3) primary, copper (.4) secondary.

tone_key.key_source: Brand colour wheel and tone key printed on chart (dual coding system)

brands.market: US editions (2026). UK range may differ.

lines.name: iNOA

developers.10 vol: up to 1 level lift; toning, refreshing
developers.20 vol: up to 2 levels; coverage of white
developers.30 vol: up to 3 levels; more visible change

lines.grey: Up to 70% white: target shade alone. 70-100%: ½ target + ½ Gold Natural (warm target) or Natural (cool target) or Extra Coverage Natural at same level; lengths use target only.
warnings: Carmilane, Rubilane and DM5 shades must be used alone (only iNOA Clear may be added). They cover up to 100% white by themselves.
lines.source: iNOA Red Melt Tech Guide, LPOCTINOA01 (US)

lines.name: Majirel

developers.20 vol: up to 2 levels; coverage of white
developers.40 vol: High-Lift only (Majicrème 40 vol due Dec 2026; Nutri-Developer until then)

lines.grey: Over 50% white: ½ target + ½ Gold (.3) at same level for warm targets, or ½ Natural for cool targets. Under 50%: target alone.
warnings: Carmilane, Rubilane and DM5 shades must not be mixed with shades from another technology family.
High-Lift does not cover white hair.
Boosters cannot be used alone with developer.

lines.name: Dia Light
warnings: DM5 and Rubilane shades must be used alone.

lines.name: Dia Color
warnings: DM5 shades marked on chart: use alone (per L'Oréal DM5 rule).

brands.name: Wella Professionals
brands.code_format: Level / primary tone + secondary tone. Doubled level (77/0) = intense. 0/xx = Special Mix (pure tone, no level).

brands.depth_source: General knowledge and Sylvie's notes; chart gives numbers only.

brands.name: TIGI copyright©olour
brands.code_format: Level / major tone + minor tone. Doubled level (66/64) = intense. A level with no slash (e.g. 8) is a neutral; /0 is natural (slightly warm). 100/ = ultra light (high lift).

tone_key.hue_source: brand wheel (/8 ash shown as a calibrated band across the cool side)

brands.name: Redken Shades EQ
brands.code_format: 0 + level of deposit + letter tones. 07NB = level 7, neutral brown. Level = how much pigment is deposited (acidic demi, no lift), not lift.
